name: composition-module-tests
description: Cross-module build-output assertion suite. Not a Hugo module: this directory holds the one fixture that imports modules/seo, modules/agent-readiness, modules/search, modules/pwa and modules/og-image TOGETHER, and asserts what only a site holding several of them can show -- that a single merged [outputs] table publishes every module's documents from one build, and that a card og-image composes reaches og:image through the seo module's generated-image hook. It carries no dependencies -- node --test, node:assert and node:zlib are enough -- so it needs no npm install of its own.
